jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**Are you ready to design the brains behind the next generation of intelligent machines? As our new Lead Engineer, you will develop the cutting-edge control systems that enable tractors, mining trucks, and construction vehicles to operate autonomously.

This isn’t just a coding job; you will be on the front lines of innovation. You will travel to customer sites, seeing your software come to life as you deploy and tune autonomous systems in challenging, real-world environments like active mines and vast agricultural fields.

Your work will directly transform the off-highway industry, making machinery safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. You will be a key technical leader, pushing the boundaries of robotics and shaping the future of industrial automation.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead the end-to-end development of autonomous control systems for heavy-duty off-highway vehicles using ROS2 and modern C/C++.

• Design, test, and optimize complex algorithms for sensor fusion, path planning, and vehicle navigation, integrating data from LiDAR, cameras, and GNSS/GPS.

• Travel to customer sites to deploy, tune, and validate your autonomous solutions on real-world machinery in the agriculture, construction, and mining industries.

• Bridge the gap between high-level software and vehicle hardware by developing embedded control solutions using Danfoss’ PLUS+1 platform.

• Ensure the highest levels of system reliability and safety by leading rigorous testing and adhering to functional safety standards like ISO 13849.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Bachelors Degree in an Engineering related field with 8+ years of experience developing complex robotics applications using ROS2, combined with strong software engineering skills in C/C++ within a Linux environment.

• A solid understanding of vehicle dynamics, control systems, and onboard communication networks like CAN bus.

• Hands-on experience with perception and localization sensors such as LiDAR, cameras, and GNSS/GPS, including sensor fusion techniques.

• Knowledge of functional safety standards (ISO 13849/25119) and experience working with safety-critical systems.

• Excellent communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the willingness to travel to customer sites for hands-on system deployment and support.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 401k, annual bonus, paid vacation, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the range for this position. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. For US-based candidates, the range for this position is $100,000 to $150,000.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Every year, European governments spend billions on mobility: subsidies, contracts, licences, public transport. Most of that money is spent with no clear idea of what it buys for society.

We're building the tech layer that changes that.

**What We Do

**Impact Market builds MIMA, the Mobility Impact Market. On our platform, cities and transport authorities incentivise mobility operators (bike share, e-scooters, car-pooling, car sharing, bike leasing) for trips according to their benefit to society: a car trip replaced, emissions avoided, space and congestion saved, health improved, a neighbourhood connected. By estimating the socio-economic impact of each trip, we design smart incentives that get the most social value out of public funds.

The idea is much bigger than mobility: governments paying for the outcomes they want, with the evidence to back it up. Mobility is our first market, and we intend to move into other areas of public spending.

**Where we are

**

• Funded with 12+ months runway

• Several paying public-sector clients

• A production platform (prod + staging), with live trip and rider-survey data from operators flowing in since August 2026

• A team of 3. You'd be number 4.

**The role

**You'll be our first technical hire and will lead product and engineering. For now that means hands fully dirty: you write the code. No agencies, no outsourcing.

• Own the platform. Rust, Postgres, cloud, our RiderSurvey API, and the data pipelines from operators. You'll inherit a working MVP and decide what to keep, what to rebuild and what to build next.

• Make the big calls, including the language. We chose Rust deliberately: we think a strict compiler and type system are the right guardrails for building fast with AI. If you have a better argument for something else, convince us.

• Be AI-native. We expect you to use AI seriously in coding and every other technical task. That's how a team of four does the work of fifteen.

• Build agents that run the company with us, for account management, client reporting and forecasting.

• Grow into the science. Together with a future R&D lead, you'll work on the statistical significance of measured impacts and on forecasting how markets respond to incentives.

• Shape the product with the founders and our clients. You'll be in the room with transport authorities, not behind a ticket queue.

**You

**

• Have minimum 4 years of relevant experience shipping production software, ideally backend or data-heavy systems

• Senior and still love writing code every day? Even better.

• Know Rust, or are genuinely motivated to go deep in it (not just "willing"). (We are not dogmatic about Rust, but we have a working platform built with care, so changing direction would take strong conviction.)

• Already build with AI tools daily and have opinions about how to do it well

• Are comfortable with data: SQL, pipelines, and an appetite for statistics and forecasting

• Take ownership when things are ambiguous, and like it when nobody tells you how

• Care about the mission. You don't need to have read our founder's book, The Next Democracy, but its core ideas about how citizens and governments could work together - is fundamental to what we do. If they don’t excite you, this probably isn’t the right fit.

Bonus points for experience in mobility or transport, govtech, causal inference or experimentation, or privacy-by-design and GDPR.

**What We Offer

**

• A real say in everything. Stack, product, architecture, culture and who we hire next.

• Title decided together. We're advertising this as CTO / Founding Engineer and will settle the title with you based on your experience and ambitions.

• Competitive startup salary plus a meaningful warrant package, designed to make total compensation comparable with bigger-company offers

• 5 weeks of holiday and flexible hours

• Work that matters. Help redirect public money towards what actually improves people's lives.

**Location

**Copenhagen is our home, and we'd love you here; relocation is very welcome. If you stay elsewhere, you must be based in the EU and work in EU time zones. You'd spend your first 1–2 months with us in Copenhagen, then 2–4 days here every month after that.

**Process

**

• Quick online intro call with Erdem (CEO)

• In-person meeting

• A challenge based on a real problem from our platform

• Second meeting with the team

• Offer

**Do you want to help ensure reliable documentation for electrical infrastructure projects? Can you bring structure to complex documentation flows and secure complete project records? And do you have at least five years of experience in document control? Then join COWI as our new Document Controller.

****Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Document Controller to join COWI and support our customer's electrical infrastructure projects. You will help ensure that both internal project documentation and supplier documentation are collected, organised and securely archived. Following an introduction to the relevant processes, methods and systems, you will work with minimal supervision to ensure complete project documentation through to final handover and project closure.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Set up archiving structures in the customer's electronic document and records management system and clarify which documentation must be collected and retained.

• Collect and secure internal project documentation from customer-managed SharePoint sites, as well as photographic documentation and other project records.

• Collect and secure supplier documentation, including collaborating with the customer's IT team on developing APIs or automation tools where needed.

• Ensure that final as-built documentation is complete, that projects comply with the customer's archiving guidelines, and that sites and platforms are closed down at project completion.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

• At least five years of experience in document control.

• Experience with electronic document management (EDM) systems, an aptitude for IT and a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office

• Experience managing electronic workflows and as-built documentation.

• Good written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English.

• A structured and thorough approach, enjoyment of process-oriented tasks, and a service-minded, collaborative and practical attitude. You are motivated and engaged, with a focus on helping projects succeed

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Your role

This is not a pure channel management role. You will own how we acquire users and merchants, from the first ad impression to the first cashback earned.

We are looking for a hands-on marketing specialist who combines deep paid media skills with a structured, test-driven mindset. You care about clicks and installs, but more about activated users who stay, shop and earn. You set up the experiments, read the data and make the call.

You report to our Chief Growth Officer and play a central role in scaling Loyalty Key across the Nordics. You get real budget, real ownership and short decision paths.

Working at Loyalty Key

Loyalty Key is building the Nordic standard for payment-linked loyalty. Our technology turns everyday card payments into automatic rewards: no coupons, no points, no receipts. Just cashback, straight to the consumer, every time they shop with a partner.

We power loyalty for some of the region's strongest brands, including Visa, Danske Bank and SAS EuroBonus, and connect consumers with more than 2,000 merchants. Our own consumer app, Cashback med Visa, puts that network directly in people's pockets.

We are a Copenhagen-based team with an ambitious plan: to make card-linked cashback something every Nordic cardholder uses, and every merchant wants to be part of.

What you will own

Your main focus is consumer growth: getting the right people to download the app, sign up and start earning. You will also drive lead generation towards merchants who want to join our network.

Performance roadmap

• 
Own the paid acquisition roadmap across channels and markets

• 
Identify what limits growth today, and prioritize the work that moves the needle

• 
Balance volume, user quality and cost, and make those trade-offs visible

Paid acquisition

• 
Run and scale campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, TikTok and Snapchat

• 
Drive app user acquisition through programmatic and mobile DSP partners

• 
Manage budgets, pacing and channel allocation

Creative and messaging

• 
Build a structured creative testing framework: hypothesis, variant, iteration

• 
Brief designers, UGC creators and agency partners with clear, data-backed direction

• 
Find the hooks, offers and merchant stories that turn attention into signups

Landing pages and conversion

• 
Own conversion beyond the ad click: landing pages, app store listings and signup flows

• 
Run A/B tests on pages, offers and onboarding steps

• 
Optimize for activated users, not just installs

Agency and partner management

• 
Lead our external performance agency with clear goals and accountability for results

• 
Work with DSP and media partners on setup, performance and reporting

• 
Contribute to joint campaigns with brand partners such as Visa

B2B lead generation

• 
Run lead campaigns towards merchants and hand qualified leads to our sales team

• 
Follow the full path from lead to meeting to signed merchant, and optimize for quality

What you'll bring

We are looking for an experienced performance marketing specialist: deep in paid acquisition, broad enough to improve the whole funnel around it.

Essential

• 
3–5 years of experience in performance or growth marketing, in-house or agency side

• 
Deep hands-on expertise in Meta Ads and Google Ads

• 
Proven experience with at least one of TikTok, Snapchat or programmatic / mobile DSP

• 
A track record of structured creative testing, with results you can point to

• 
Hands-on experience with landing page optimization and A/B testing

• 
Strong analytical skills: you build your own reports and let data drive decisions

• 
Experience leading agencies or media partners towards commercial goals

• 
High ownership and a bias for action: you get things live and iterate

• 
Fluent English, written and spoken

Strongly preferred

• 
App marketing experience, including mobile attribution tools such as Adjust or AppsFlyer

• 
A background in fintech, loyalty, e-commerce or consumer apps

• 
B2B lead generation experience, ideally with HubSpot or a similar CRM

• 
Experience running campaigns across several markets

Perks and benefits

• 
Competitive salary

• 
Pension scheme

• 
Health insurance

• 
Lunch scheme

• 
Social events

• 
Personal learning budget

Our recruitment process

• 
Interview with our Chief Growth Officer (60 min): your experience, your way of working and the results you have driven

• 
Case presentation (45 min): you present a short growth plan based on a case we share with you in advance

Equal opportunity

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. We hire on skills, experience and potential, and we believe diverse teams build better products.

Start date and location:

Start date by agreement.

Address: Dampfærgevej 21, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

Do you have any questions?

For further information, please contact Allan Stolc, aas@loyaltykey.com

We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send us a motivated application, your CV and any other relevant documents as soon as possible.

Do you like testing complex systems and working closely with developers? We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our Product Extension Team in Copenhagen. You will bring senior test expertise to a small team that builds integrations and extensions for Systematic's defence products, with real influence on how we test and improve.

The job

As the team's senior tester, you will be its quality advocate, driving how we test and improve across the full development lifecycle. You will combine hands-on test execution with real influence over our testing tools, methods and processes.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Planning, estimating and executing test activities, and contributing to test estimates in project planning

• Driving quality across the development lifecycle through risk-based test design

• Developing and maintaining system-level automated tests that support feature testing

• Challenging developers and projects on where automation makes the most sense, including weak points in developer-driven tests

• Improving our test tools, methods and processes

You should expect occasional travel of around five to ten days a year, mostly within Europe. Some onsite hardware testing may also be required, depending on integration needs.

Joining the team

You will be part of the Product Extension Team in Defence Services, around seven developers, test engineers and architects. The team delivers software and hardware integrations such as sensor interfaces, radio drivers and interoperability solutions with external systems, so our customers get functionality tailored to their needs without compromising on quality or maintainability. As the team's senior tester, you will work closely with developers, architects, project management, external system providers and customer representatives, and share your knowledge by mentoring our junior test engineer and running workshops.

Your qualifications

To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience in software and/or systems testing, along with:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Technology or similar

• Experience with test management and test design methods

• The ability to drive the implementation of test frameworks and tools, and to review and adapt existing automated test setups

• Familiarity with integrations, APIs, protocols and hardware validation setups

• Experience with tools like JUnit, Cucumber, Playwright, Jira, Xray, Karma and TeamCity, or similar

• Fluent English; Danish is a nice-to-have

ISTQB Foundation certification, or similar, is an advantage but not a requirement.

Alongside this, we value:

• A proactive and independent approach, with strong analytical skills and a risk-based mindset

• An ability to build relationships and work across teams and projects

• Curiosity about customer needs and how the system is actually used

• A willingness to share information openly and help others learn

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations—you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Andreas Markussen, Senior Manager.

Ambu A/S is looking for a Senior Portfolio Management Consultant to join the Innovation PMO.

You will work with complex, cross-functional topics related to portfolio management, governance and business performance. Your role is to define the problem, build the fact base, align stakeholders, recommend solutions and establish ownership for implementation.

Reporting to the Director, Innovation PMO, you will work closely with colleagues across the PMO and senior stakeholders across Ambu.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

Key responsibilities

• 
Cross-functional initiatives

• 
Drive selected cross-functional topics from problem definition through analysis, recommendation and stakeholder alignment.

• 
Define decisions, actions and ownership, and hand over execution to the relevant business owner.

• 
Portfolio governance and ways of working

• 
Evaluate and improve processes for project portfolio prioritization, resource management, project governance and performance follow-up.

• 
Translate business goals and requirements and input from subject-matter experts into clear processes, roles, decision criteria and governance.

• 
Analysis and decision support

• 
Analyse portfolio, project, resource and business-performance information to identify issues and recommend actions.

• 
Develop scenarios, recommendations and decision material for senior management.

• 
Management support

• 
Take ownership of selected analyses and cross-functional topics on behalf of the Director, Innovation PMO.

• 
Prepare recommendations, presentation material and follow up agreed actions with relevant stakeholders.

Suggested candidate profile

**Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have relevant experience within project portfolio management, management consulting, PMO, business transformation or operational excellence.

• Have taken complex, cross-functional business problems from initial question to analysis, recommendation and agreed action.

• Have aligned senior stakeholders across functions, including situations with different priorities and no direct reporting relationship.

• Have hands-on experience with portfolio management, prioritization, governance, resource management and/or performance reporting.

• Have prepared analyses, decision recommendations and presentation material for senior management.

• Can work independently with loosely defined assignments, while knowing when to involve subject-matter experts and decision-makers.

• Communicate clearly and concisely in English, both in writing and presentations.

Experience from MedTech or another regulated industry is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

jobs.occupation: Sr. Business Analyst for Accounting Data & Monitoring
jobs.description:
Would you like to join the Accounting Data & Monitoring team in Reporting Solutions responsible for several business-critical data hubs of accounting and financial data used in business solutions and reporting processes? Do you want to participate in the data tech transformation in BEC, soon to be Nykredit Financial Technologies?

BEC is looking for a Business Analyst to join the Reporting Solutions domain. The position will be based at our friendly office in Roskilde or Warsaw.

Reporting Solutions plays a vital role in ensuring compliance of BEC’s member banks by managing a portfolio of 40+ business solutions within the business areas of Credit Risk and Finance Solutions, including several business-critical data hubs that support banks' business processes, internal reporting, and obligations in regulatory reporting.

You will join the Accounting Data & Monitoring team with responsibility for both maintenance and development of a portfolio of business solutions that ensure accurate, reliable, and traceable accounting and financial data across business solutions and reporting processes. Part of the business solutions are managed in a partnership with Accenture.

You will join a high‑performing, cross‑functional team, combining solid business knowledge with strong software engineering practices. The team works with Mainframe, Netezza, SAS, Kafka, and Databricks platforms and does coding in Cobol, Java, Python, and SQL and apply BI tools such as PowerCenter an SAP Business Objects. The team is currently situated in Herning, Roskilde and Warsaw but will transition and consolidate in Roskilde and Warsaw by end of 2027.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of BEC’s data tech transformation, using modern, Cloud-based technologies and event‑driven architectures to build scalable data products to substitute for current business solutions. This will give banks easier access to trusted, consistent data, whether for self-service analytics, reporting, regulatory requirements, or operational processes.

Primary task and responsibilities include:

• Manage incidents and problems effectively in close collaboration with colleagues and clients.

• Explore and analyse complex accounting and financial datasets to identify patterns, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement of financial systems and reporting processes.

• Translate business and accounting requirements into analytical use cases and communicate insights to stakeholders both internally in BEC and clients.

• Collaborate closely with Business Analysts, Software Engineers, and Architects in Reporting Solutions to ensure high-quality, reliable, and well‑governed data foundations.

• Build analytical data products and models that support regulatory reporting and decision‑making across the financial domain.

• Participate in the data tech transformation towards a modern data platform using Databricks.

• Work with Databricks, Python, and SQL to develop scalable data science solutions.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of the development process and client engagement.

To succeed you will have:

• A relevant Master degree.

• 5y+ work experience as Business Analyst from Banking or financial IT.

• Preferably, work experience from the banking sector in Denmark.

• Extensive knowledge of accounting, financial, and regulatory data like an accountant or bookkeeper.

• Extensive experience working with large and complex datasets.

• Preferably, experience of modern platforms such as Databricks

• Understand data modelling concepts and data governance principles.

• Preferably, programming skills in SQL and Python.

• Experience of working in agile setups like Scrum or SAFe.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Fluency in English, written and spoken.

• Danish is an advantage.

As a person, you are ambitious, goal oriented, and persistent. You have a curious and analytical mindset. You are a team player who is proactive and takes responsibility. You are service minded towards both clients and colleagues.

Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Pension scheme

• Health and dentist insurance

• Referral bonus

What does the recruitment process look like?

• Send us your CV: We want to get to know you

• Screening call: Let's chat and see if we're a match

• Meet your future manager and team: See who you'll be working closely with.

• Personality and cognitive test: Let's learn more about you.

• Meet our talent partner and your future manager once more: Get feedback on your test results.

• Time to sign the contract: We're ready to welcome you to BEC!

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Attraction Partner Anders Skak-Arnstrup at rud@bec.dk.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

Application due: 11/11/2026

Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our new Machine Learning Engineer

Machine learning is becoming an increasingly important part of how we understand energy markets, improve forecasts, and make trading decisions. We are therefore looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to move our models from research to production, building robust, scalable pipelines that continuously improve our strategies.

At Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET), we combine deep market expertise with machine learning, quantitative research, data, and engineering to automate and optimise how we trade power. We’re a small, highly ambitious team based in central Copenhagen, specialising in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is at the core of how we operate, supported by one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets.

The Opportunity

Energy markets produce vast amounts of data and are continuously shaped by weather, power production, transmission constraints, and market behaviour. Using that data meaningfully requires accurate models and reliable software and infrastructure that allow those models to run in production.

As our Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll work across machine learning and software development. Alongside quantitative researchers, software engineers and traders, you’ll build the production systems behind our ML pipelines, making our trading more performant, more reliable and more automated.

You’ll own the full lifecycle around the model: from data management to the pipelines and frameworks that deploy and monitor our models, keeping them reliable and adaptive as markets evolve. The opportunity for impact is large, and so is what it asks of you: dedication, real talent and the willingness to grind through hard problems. This is a hands-on engineering role at the centre of how CET uses machine learning to trade.

What You Will Do

• Strengthen our ML framework: Build and improve the framework our researchers use to build models and quantitative strategies.

• Build production-ready software: Design and develop reliable, scalable, and well-tested Python software that integrates machine learning into our internal trading platforms.

• Develop data infrastructure: Build and maintain data pipelines and storage solutions for ingesting, transforming, and serving diverse market and fundamental data.

• Ship and operate models: Take models from experiment to production, including deployment, serving, monitoring and experiment tracking

• Improve our ML and engineering practices: Help strengthen our approach to MLOps, testing, CI/CD, code reviews, and the wider model development lifecycle.

• Shape our technical solutions: Evaluate and introduce tools and technologies that improve how we develop, deploy, and operate machine learning solutions.

• Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with quantitative researchers, traders, and software engineers to turn business and market needs into practical technical solutions.

• Build energy-market expertise: Develop a deep understanding of power markets and how machine learning, data, and software can improve trading decisions.

What We're Looking For

We value strong technical ability, sound judgement, curiosity, and motivation to learn. While we don't expect a perfect match, many of the following qualifications will help you succeed in the role:

• Strong software engineering skills: Experience building clean, scalable, tested, and production-ready software. Strong Python skills are essential, as Python is our primary development language.

• MLOps and development practices: Proficiency in Git, code reviews, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model deployment, and monitoring.

• Cloud computing: Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP, ideally including relevant data and machine learning services.

• Problem-solving and communication: The ability to structure complex problems, communicate clearly, and collaborate with colleagues across technical and commercial disciplines. Full professional proficiency in English is required.

• Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• Interest in energy markets: Curiosity about power markets, trading, and energy systems. Previous experience in energy or trading is an advantage, but not a requirement.

• Education: A degree with a strong technical focus, e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, or other relevant fields. We welcome different educational backgrounds and levels of qualification.

What We Offer

• Growth environment: Become part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive salary package and attractive benefits that reflect your skills and contributions.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, team-building, and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

How to Apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply via LinkedIn and submit your cover letter, CV, and university transcripts as a single PDF. Please note that applications that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.

Application deadline: November 27, 2026

If you have any questions, please contact Carl Frederik Grønvald (Senior Quantitative Analyst) at cfg@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann (People & Culture Manager) at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our next Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading (Short-term Power Markets)

Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET) shapes the future of the energy transition by combining deep market expertise with technical excellence in data, quantitative research and engineering to drive, automate and optimise our trading operations.

We’re a small, elite team based in central Copenhagen specializing in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is core to how we operate, powered by exceptional talent and one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. But we're not done. We want to push automation and advanced analytics even further, and to do that we need more exceptional people.

The Opportunity

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an outstanding Quantitative Researcher with a proven track record of building real-time algorithmic trading strategies that operate with high reliability in regulated industries. You'll play a key role in developing strategies for the European short-term power markets.

This isn't a narrow coding or analyst role. You'll have an end-to-end mandate, from prototyping and data engineering to strategy implementation, backtesting and low-latency execution in our algorithmic trading framework. You'll own your projects from idea to P&L, working autonomously alongside a close-knit group of software engineers, quantitative researchers and expert traders.

So, if you feel energized by the intersection of markets, advanced analytics and trading technology and you want to help build something that moves power to where it’s needed the most, then we must talk.

Responsibilities

• Research and model the markets: Analyse energy market dynamics and turn your insights into predictive models that drive profitable trading strategies.

• Own the data: Build and maintain high-quality datasets that combine fundamental and real-time market data.

• Take strategies to production and keep them running: Own the path from research to live trading, shaping the systems, forecasting tools and data pipelines that run our strategies in real time. Once they're live, you'll monitor their performance, handle issues as they come up and make sure they trade reliably day to day.

• Shape the team's direction: Work closely with engineers, quantitative researchers and traders to challenge ideas, share expertise and influence where we take our algorithmic trading next.

• Master the domain: Become a domain expert and understand algorithmic trading architectures and order execution logic in the short-term power markets.

Who are you?

You have:

• Quantitative expertise: A track record of building accurate forecasting models and trading strategies for financial or energy markets, with a rigorous approach to research and validation.

• Software and data skills: Advanced Python skills, and the ability to write clean, efficient, reliable code, backed by solid computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design). Strong data skills, from sourcing and cleaning to structuring complex datasets. Some experience with C++ would be a plus.

• Ownership: The ability to work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication: Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with full professional proficiency in English.

• Domain knowledge: A genuine interest in learning about power markets and systems. If you already have that domain knowledge, then that is a big plus.

• Education: An advanced degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or Engineering.

What We Offer

• Growth environment: Be part of a young, ambitious, and expanding tech-driven trading company where talented people are given responsibility and room to grow.

• Exceptional team: Work closely with experienced quantitative researchers, software engineers and power traders.

• Competitive compensation and flexibility: Receive a competitive salary package with benefits and enjoy flexible work arrangements that support your work-life balance.

• Strong culture: Participate in both social and professional events, including team sports, company parties, teambuilding and informal gatherings that strengthen our team spirit.

• Central Copenhagen location: Work from our office in Carlsberg Byen, located in beautifully renovated historic Carlsberg buildings.

About Copenhagen Energy Trading

Copenhagen Energy Trading A/S was founded in 2021 and is part of Copenhagen Energy Group.

We specialize in short-term power trading across Europe and North America. Through technology, data, and market expertise, we develop discretionary and algorithmic trading strategies that help move power to where it is needed most.

Based in Copenhagen, we are building a collaborative, high-performance environment where talented people are trusted with responsibility and given the freedom to make an impact.

How to apply

If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply via LinkedIn and submit your cover letter, CV, and university transcripts as a single PDF. Please note that applications that do not meet these requirements may not be considered.

If you have any questions, please contact Jens Christian Johannsen at jc@copenhagen-energy.com or Anna Schumann at as@copenhagen-energy.com.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

The role

As our Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own the processes and data behind our sales organization: the sales process, definitions, forecasting and commissions.

This is an individual contributor role in our Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security. You'll be supported by the RevOps team and work closely with sales leadership and Finance. We're looking for around 5+ years of hands-on experience in VC or PE-backed companies.

What you'll do

Forecasting

• Define shared sales terms and metrics such as pipeline, stage probabilities, bookings, and new versus expansion business.

• Establish a forecasting baseline: forecast categories, submission rules and a first method for new business and expansion.

• Track forecast accuracy and refine the method as data quality improves.

• Build pipeline and forecast reports and dashboards in Salesforce.

• Set up a pipeline and forecast review cadence with sales leadership once the definitions are in place.

Sales process

• Own the sales process from qualified opportunity to closed deal, including stages, exit criteria and the hand-over to delivery and Finance.

• Set up territories, account ownership and rules for partner and cross-sell deals.

Commissions

• Help automate the commission process with the right tooling, from data capture to calculation and payout.

• Work with Finance and sales leadership on plan design and changes.

Sales systems

• Shape how Salesforce (including Revenue Cloud/CPQ) supports the sales process, and make hands-on changes where needed.

• Keep sales data clean with required fields, validation rules and deduplication.

• Automate manual steps in the sales process with workflows and AI.

• Work with CRM vendors and implementation partners, including evaluations, renewals, support and new functionality.

• Train and support sales reps on system and process changes.

Stack harmonization

We grow through acquisition. In October 2026 we announced our combination with WoodWing, adding four products and more than 200 colleagues. Harmonizing the sales stack and processes of acquired companies is a big part of this job, done together with the RevOps team and the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security.

• Bring each acquired sales team, starting with WoodWing, onto our shared sales process, pipeline stages, definitions and reporting.

• Move acquired sales reps onto group commission plans.

• Set account ownership and cross-sell rules between entities, and resolve duplicate accounts.

• Assess each acquired company's sales systems and migrate accounts, contacts, opportunities and products into Salesforce in phases, including from HubSpot.

• Build a repeatable playbook for the next acquisition.

Your qualifications

Essential

• Around 5+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations in B2B SaaS

• Experience building a sales forecast from the ground up, including the definitions and data quality behind it

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reports, dashboards and flows

• Experience designing and rolling out sales processes

• Experience administering sales commissions

• Experience consolidating CRMs or sales processes after an acquisition, or running sales operations across several entities

• Good understanding of sales metrics such as pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle and bookings

• Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets

Nice to have

• HubSpot experience, including migrating from HubSpot to Salesforce

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ experience

• Experience implementing commission software

• Using AI in sales workflows

Soft skills

You're comfortable with change and ambiguity, as our processes keep developing with each acquisition. You build trust with sales leaders and sales reps, prefer practical solutions you can improve over time, and help new colleagues adapt to shared ways of working.

HEGSØ Search & Consulting has the task of finding a skilled Machine Learning Engineer for our client, the leading subsea technology and development company Teledyne RESON.

Job Purpose:

Turn noisy, real-time sensor data into robust machine-learning solutions.

As Machine Learning Engineer you join a multidisciplinary engineering team developing ML for target detection, sonar imaging and pattern recognition in streaming acoustic data. Your work will connect sensors, signal processing, high-performance computing and the information ultimately presented to users.

The sensor systems generate large volumes of real-time data, which is transformed into software products for visualization, post-processing and analysis. The processing chain combines demanding real-time computation with FPGA, DSP and GPU hardware.

You will help develop both the ML models and the infrastructure around them. Because the ML infrastructure supports internal development and customer on-site use, robustness, efficiency and control are central to the role. You will work with industry-standard tools as well as in-house technology.

This is a rare opportunity to apply machine learning to difficult, meaningful data alongside maritime domain experts, software engineers, mathematical modelling engineers and embedded-processing specialists.

What makes the role distinctive:

• Challenging data – find structures and patterns in noisy streaming acoustic and hydrophone data

• End-to-end impact – work from sensor input and model development through to information presented to the user

• Industrial ML – turn novel ML technology into robust, efficient products for internal and customer use

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop machine-learning and data-science solutions for target detection in sonar acoustic data and imaging systems

• Identify structures and patterns in data from hydrophones

• Develop ML models and contribute to the ML infrastructure used in the software products

• Be an active member of a development team spanning software, mathematical modelling and dedicated embedded-processing hardware

• Communicate concepts across the development chain, from sensor input to the final information presented to the user

• Propose improvements to ML models and infrastructure

• Help bring novel ML technologies into robust, industrialized products

• Keep current with relevant technologies and tools

Essential skills:

• Experience with general machine-learning technologies, modern modelling techniques and deep-learning frameworks – PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar

• Understanding of software quality assurance principles and build tools, plus a successful track record in ML development

• Ability to manage and span substantial multi-year engineering efforts while contributing as a hands-on team player

• Strong technical communication skills and proficiency in English

Useful additional experience:

• A background in mathematics, physics or optics, with an understanding of the physics and nature of acoustics

• Experience with related signal-processing domains such as hearing aids, 5G telecom, radar or ultrasound

• Experience with relevant software and tools such as Git, Jira and build systems

Qualifications & Experience:

• An MSc or PhD in engineering is a strong foundation, but an experienced professional background can be equally relevant

• The right candidate may come from different disciplines and career paths

Behavioural Competencies:

• Self-driven, enjoys difficult technical challenges and keeps pushing toward ambitious goals

• Collaborates well and communicates well in a global team distributed between countries

• Takes ownership and responsibility, delivers to agreements and keeps promises

• Enthusiastic, energetic ‘can-do’ attitude

• Interested in new technologies, industry challenges and in the products, use cases, customers and the marine domain

What we offer:

• A collaborative workplace with strong colleagues and a company that takes good care of its employees

• A high level of ambition and the time to build high-quality products within a company recognized globally for world-class sonar systems

• A development path that supports your continued professional growth

• Interesting products, markets and customers, including leading research organizations, global industrial companies and defence organizations

About Teledyne RESON: Teledyne RESON is a world leader in high-quality underwater acoustic solutions – multibeam sonars, sensors, transducers and survey software. Founded in Denmark in 1976 and part of Teledyne since 2013, with headquarters, R&D and production in Slangerup.

Job location

Copenhagen, Denmark is preferred because close collaboration between ML and software engineers is important to the role.

• Bring each acquired sales team, starting with WoodWing, onto our shared sales process, pipeline stages, definitions and reporting.

• Move acquired sales reps onto group commission plans.

• Set account ownership and cross-sell rules between entities, and resolve duplicate accounts.

• Assess each acquired company's sales systems and migrate accounts, contacts, opportunities and products into Salesforce in phases, including from HubSpot.

• Build a repeatable playbook for the next acquisition.

Your qualifications

Essential

• Around 5+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations in B2B SaaS

• Experience building a sales forecast from the ground up, including the definitions and data quality behind it

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reports, dashboards and flows

• Experience designing and rolling out sales processes

• Experience administering sales commissions

• Experience consolidating CRMs or sales processes after an acquisition, or running sales operations across several entities

• Good understanding of sales metrics such as pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle and bookings

• Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets

Nice to have

• HubSpot experience, including migrating from HubSpot to Salesforce

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ experience

• Experience implementing commission software

• Using AI in sales workflows

Soft skills

You're comfortable with change and ambiguity, as our processes keep developing with each acquisition. You build trust with sales leaders and sales reps, prefer practical solutions you can improve over time, and help new colleagues adapt to shared ways of working.

What kind of company is Omnidocs?

We recognize that in different phases of life, you need different kinds of flexibility, and we are happy to provide that. It could be that you prefer to work from home once or twice a week or occasionally need to leave early for a soccer tournament, a parents’ meeting, or a romantic date. We find small talk between co-workers valuable, so your lunch break is part of your working hours, and we invest in quality coffee beans for the cozy and useful interactions across teams by the coffee machine. It may sound like little things, but the overall message is that we want you to meet trust, kindness, and helpfulness at work because we expect that this is what you bring as well. The purpose of our company is just as internal as it is externally communicated: We make every workday work better.

We also love to connect. We do social activities such as LAN parties, board game afternoons, and Friday Cafes. Our office is located in the heart of the historic neighborhood of Christianshavn, surrounded by canals and great little cafés and restaurants. We have plenty of light and air while being close to everything – including the metro, the canals, and the city center.

How to apply – important information!

As we strive to have an unbiased recruitment process, we ask you to be attentive to the following when applying.

1- Include a resume with relevant professional experience, skillset, and educational background.

2- Answer all required questions in the submission form when uploading.

3- Use the dedicated application link (do not send your resume over e-mail).

4- Do NOT share: a cover letter / motivated application a picture of yourself (if it’s part of your resume, please remove it before uploading) information about your gender or sex your first name (enter the first letter of your first name instead) your age or birth date

Processing of personal data By registering in our HR system, BambooHR, and uploading both application and CV, you accept that Omnidocs stores the registered data about you and the data included in the uploaded documents. All information is used solely for recruitment purposes and will be deleted within 12 months of upload. Please do not include person-sensitive data in the application and CV, e.g. CPR number, information about race, religion, trade union conditions, and health information. You can read about Omnidocs' guidelines for processing personal data here: https://omnidocs.com/processing-of-personal-data-in-the-context-of-recruitment/

jobs.occupation: Data engineer for analytics platform with BI expertise and an interest in the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services?

We are looking for a Data Engineer with BI expertise to join our Data and Analytics team at Nordic RCC. If you are excited about building robust data pipelines, developing high‑quality BI products, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making in a mission‑driven organization, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

**Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a Data Engineer who likes to make a difference!

**Job Description

**The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs.

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user-friendly data services.

**Responsibilities

**Your work will directly influence how Nordic RCC uses data to improve processes, services, and operational decision-making. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets.

• Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights.

• Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user-facing analytics environments, and supporting applications.

• Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services.

• Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads.

• Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready analytics solutions.

• Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service-oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service.

• Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.

**We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications:

**

• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar.

• Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts.

• Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar.

• Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments.

• Experience with cloud-native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar.

• Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure

• Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service-oriented delivery models is an advantage.

• Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for.

**Working Environment

**You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values.

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days.

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team-lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year.

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Application & Security Clearance

**Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

AXON Networks delivers a robust AI-driven, analytics-based orchestration platform and a wide portfolio of next-gen high-speed routers that leverage the newest Wi-Fi technologies. Together, these technologies give ISPs the ability to manage and troubleshoot their networks in real time, and to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

AXON Networks is a trusted strategic partner for its customers, helping them evaluate their current technologies and business models, and creating and executing strategies that enable them to innovate faster, accelerate their digital transformations, and strengthen their relationships with consumers.

AXON Networks is headquartered in Irvine, CA USA with Asia HQ in Singapore and also operating in Denmark, Spain and Vietnam.

We are looking for a mid-level Python developer with strong software-engineering fundamentals and experience building production backend systems.

You should be comfortable designing, testing, and maintaining Python applications independently, while using LLM-assisted coding tools critically and responsibly.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build asynchronous Python services and FastAPI-based APIs

• Design modular, loosely coupled components with clear responsibilities

• Integrate databases, APIs, and external services

• Develop agentic applications using frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK or Pydantic AI

• Write type-safe, well-tested, maintainable code

• Containerize services using Docker

• Review both human-written and AI-generated code

**Requirement

**

• Strong Python and asyncio knowledge

• Experience with FastAPI and API design

• Modular design, separation of concerns, and loose coupling

• Database integration and connector experience

• Python type annotations and static type checking

• Unit testing with pytest

• Modern Python tooling such as uv, ruff, mypy, or pyright

• Docker and microservice fundamentals

• Git and collaborative development workflows

**Agentic AI Experience

**

• Experience with an agent framework such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Pydantic AI, or LangGraph

• Understanding of tool calling, structured outputs, context management, guardrails, and evaluation

• Experience using AI-assisted coding tools

• Ability to assess AI-generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit

**Nice to Have

**

• Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, or document databases

• Familiarity with SQLAlchemy or asynchronous database drivers

**Benefits

**

• Competitive remuneration package

• Health insurance

• Pension Scheme

• Flexi time, hybrid work

• Friendly office environment (pool table, darts board and gaming corner)

• Daily catered lunch, sodas, coffee, snacks, etc.

Join AXON Networks!

At AXON Networks, we promote equal opportunities in all our recruitment processes, ensuring non-discrimination on the basis of gender, age, origin, disability, or any other personal circumstances. We assess talent based on objective criteria and foster an inclusive and diverse working environment.

Join Connected Cars on our mission to connect millions of car owners with their vehicles by tapping into the on-board diagnostics available in every modern car.

About Connected Cars

Connected Cars is on a mission to transform how automotive manufacturers and distributors interact with their customers by turning vehicle data into loyal, lasting relationships. By 2030, our vision is to turn vehicle data into timely, personal moments that build trust and drive loyalty, while streamlining operations and boosting efficiency across the value chain.

Our team consists of around 70 people from diverse backgrounds and nationalities, brought together by a shared belief in team effort, community, and delivering quality products and solutions.

The Position

We are currently using Node.js (mainly TypeScript), Kubernetes, MySQL, and BigQuery on the backend, hosted on Google Cloud Platform. Having scaled our backend to a global presence, we rely heavily on Infrastructure as Code using Terraform. We believe in releasing early and often, supported by an automated CI/CD pipeline running multiple daily deployments.

Our engineers work in agile, cross-functional teams of 3–4 people with minimal overhead and bureaucracy. We empower our teams with full decision-making power over how they work, what they focus on, and how they deliver functionality.

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will architect and build robust APIs, backend services, and databases, while taking full ownership of your code from development to production monitoring (via Grafana and Google Cloud Monitoring). You will collaborate closely with other internal engineering teams and periodically communicate with external stakeholders to align on technical integrations and requirements.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a skilled, autonomous engineer with 5+ years of professional backend experience who possesses an inquisitive mind and thrives on taking full ownership of complex problems. You are driven, enthusiastic about software engineering, and proactive in figuring out what needs to be built. Beyond technical execution, you enjoy working cross-functionally and act as a supportive mentor within your team to help colleagues find effective solutions.

Key qualifications and experience:

• 5+ years of experience as a backend engineer building scalable systems.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js, TypeScript, and building RESTful/GraphQL APIs.

• Solid experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and managing large datasets (terabytes in BigQuery or similar).

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally and effectively communicate with external stakeholders.

• High degree of autonomy, problem-solving drive, and a natural curiosity to explore new technical solutions.

• Passion for high-quality code, TDD, CI/CD, and mentorship.

Our team is made up of people who genuinely enjoy the process of building things. If you have a GitHub account, a side project, or open-source experience, we’d love to hear about it.

Why Connected Cars

• A collaborative, innovative work environment that encourages growth, ownership, and technical autonomy.

• Competitive salary package and an attractive pension scheme.

• Friday bars, monthly social events, an affordable lunch scheme, and unlimited snacks in the office.

Connected Cars is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Please send your application through LinkedIn with an up-to-date CV. It is not necessary to provide a cover letter, but feel free to if there is extra information you think we should know.
